session_1.speaker: Bruno
session_1.text: Hi Ana! How was your week?

session_1.speaker: Ana
session_1.text: Great! I adopted a grey cat named Pixel from the shelter on Monday.

session_1.speaker: Bruno
session_1.text: Lovely. I started pottery classes downtown, every Thursday evening.

session_1.speaker: Ana
session_1.text: Here is Pixel sleeping on my desk.
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a grey cat on a desk

session_2.speaker: Ana
session_2.text: I ran my first half marathon in Lisbon last Sunday, 2 hours 5 minutes.

session_2.speaker: Bruno
session_2.text: Congratulations! My pottery teacher says my bowls are getting better.

session_2.speaker: Ana
session_2.text: Pixel knocked one of your bowls off the shelf, sorry!

session_3.speaker: Bruno
session_3.text: I am moving to Porto in September for a new job at a bakery.

session_3.speaker: Ana
session_3.text: Porto is beautiful. I will visit you with Pixel.

session_3.speaker: Bruno
session_3.text: Bring running shoes, there is a nice route along the river.
